title: Bulgaria PHP Conference 2019
content:
We are proud to announce the return of Bulgaria PHP Conference!

The 2019 edition will take place from the to the of in the emblematic National Palace of Culture in the heart of Sofia, Bulgaria. The conference will consist of a training day and two conference days with two tracks, an unConf, a great theme, an awesome party, exquisite food and lot's of beer (we take fun really seriously on the Balkans). 8th10thNovember

Follow us on twitter , on and on our Facebook page for more news! @bgphpconfwww.bgphp.orghttps://www.facebook.com/Bulgaria-PHP-Conference-792916594079571

Our is now , so, please, do apply and see you in November in Bulgaria! Call for Papersopen
